about: SPEC-025 AC 3: a save written by a newer version of the game (version 2): an extra world (moon), extra top-level (pets) and progress fields (gems, inv.rockets, upgrades.jump, owned.shoes, a world field best), a level past this version's last (park 25: unlocked, stars, won), a hat id (jetpack) and a seen scene (boss_moon) this version does not know, and one known field with a changed shape (progress.equip as an object). This version plays it and writes it back with version 2 and every field it had; equip stays byte-for-byte as it was (the default only in memory).
